proposals.title: REPORT ON ANIMAL WELFARE
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent analysis of material risks of operating without a company-wide animal welfare policy or restrictions on animal-sourced products linked to cruelty, reported by September 2021.
proposals.evidence: your Board unanimously recommends that you vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: SETTING TARGET AMOUNTS FOR CEO COMPENSATION
proposals.proponent: Trillium Asset Management, LLC, on behalf of multiple shareholders
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Executive Compensation Committee to consider pay grades and salary ranges of all company employees when setting CEO compensation target amounts.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST this Shareholder Proposal.
